title: Contribute to a chosen community while keeping conscience intact

sections.title: Understand the distinction
sections.body: A community contribution can be bounded and freely chosen. Visitor permission, a safe exit and an accountable organizer matter independently of how welcoming a group sounds. Contribution is not consent to indefinite membership or authority.

sections.title: Complete fictional practice material
sections.body: Complete fictional public notice: Elm Reading Circle meets Saturday 10–11 in an accessible ground-floor room. Visitors may observe or read; silence is allowed. No fee, confession or belief statement is required. Organizer Ren takes private concerns; venue staff receive unresolved conduct concerns. Help setting six paper cards on a table 9:50–10:00 is optional and ends at 10:00. No photos or visitor contact list are requested.

sections.title: Work through the supplied case
sections.body: Check access, visitor role, contribution and accountability from the notice. Propose a 10-minute contribution and explain what remains unknown about actual welcome.

sections.title: Try a different case before checking
sections.body: At an open event a host adds compulsory public confession despite a written observation option. Should the visitor comply to honor the prior help agreement?

checks.title: Compare reasoning and review the supplied result
checks.body: The notice supplies a bounded authorized task, observation route, exit and concern routes; it does not prove conduct. Later fiction: Ren confirms cards go face up, corrects one placement, and respects Jo leaving at 10:20. That is one supplied encounter, not a reader’s participation or evidence of all future safety. Partial: infer unlimited trust from friendly copy. Incorrect: treat helping as consent to membership.
criteria: Permission and actual conduct are distinguished
Conscience and a usable exit remain protected

checks.title: Check the changed case
checks.body: No. That new demand exceeds the agreed scope. Decline or leave through a suitable safe route and use an appropriate concern channel if welcome; the visitor need not test a threatening authority.
